stem: A specimen arrives after a major fixation delay. The best action is to:

options.text: Document and escalate the deviation per SOP

rationale: Documenting the deviation and following the laboratory escalation process protects interpretation and quality.

distractor_rationales.A: Concealing a fixation delay prevents appropriate interpretation and violates quality documentation principles.
distractor_rationales.B: Automatically extending every stain is not a validated correction for delayed fixation and may create new artifacts.
distractor_rationales.D: Specimens should not be discarded without following authorization, documentation, and laboratory policy.

learning_objective: Apply documentation and escalation requirements when a specimen has a major fixation delay.
